topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: The rain's been drumming on the roof since before dawn, a lullaby for the desperate. This city, she's a siren singing in the storm, and it's easy to lose your way. Got a call from a guy, his voice barely a thread over the line, his story tangled in echoes. His plane, it got caught in the weather, another story in a town where fortunes turn on a dime. Now he's wired, pacing the hotel room, because he missed the big event, whatever it was. Doesn't matter, the end of the world in his eyes. I get it. We've all been the ghost at our own party, watching what could've been slip through our fingers. But this rain, it doesn't discriminate. It washes over everyone, rich or poor, lucky or cursed. And all I can think is, how do we keep moving when the world feels soaked through and heavy?
